title: Silent GetFontDefault fallback when assets/fonts is missing while data/ resolves — the only silent wrong-font path (wrong-cwd launches exit loudly at catalogs first)
detail: App and harness exit loudly when data/*.json are unreadable (main.odin:144-146 os.exit(1); harness exits 2), so only a state with data/ present but assets/fonts unreadable reaches this path: the app then silently renders the removed illegible default font; 'bin/harness save' silently re-blesses wrong-font T2s.
recommended_fix: Surface the fallback at the code level (fmt.eprintln when IsFontValid fails, or refuse to start/save), or embed the TTF bytes like DEFAULT_PALETTE_JSON to remove the runtime file dependency.

title: Sub-min-size windows are unguarded in code: chip clamps to 64px but still overlaps the forecast card below win_w 1128; top band collapses below 980
evidence:
rl.SetWindowMinSize(MIN_WIN_W, MIN_WIN_H) // clamp so the HUD bands can't collapse
--- main.odin:27-29 (the in-code derivation): // clamp so the HUD can't collapse. MIN_WIN_W = the narrowest width where the // top band fits without overlap: the health card (460px centered) right edge // W/2+230 must clear the forecast panel's left edge W-260 => W > 980; the ---
			gap_l := f32(app.view.win_w) / 2 + 240 // health card right edge + 10
			gap_r := f32(app.view.win_w) - 260     // forecast card left edge - 10
			avail := gap_r - gap_l
			chip_w := f32(clamp(i32(avail), 64, 120))
detail: The clamp floors chip WIDTH at 64 but still draws the chip at gap_l: for win_w < 1128 (avail < 64) it overlaps the forecast card, and below 980 the health card overlaps it too. SetWindowMinSize is a WM hint that tiling managers (i3/sway) don't enforce on tiled windows — no in-code guard.
recommended_fix: Add a code-side floor: skip the pause chip when avail < 64 (win_w < 1128), and/or clamp drawn HUD band geometry to the 1152x648 design minimum regardless of the live window size.
